name: MMS-TTS Hindi
description: This model, based on the MMS-TTS architecture, is designed for high-quality, efficient text-to-speech synthesis in Hindi. It excels in converting text into natural-sounding speech, making it ideal for various applications such as voice assistants, audiobooks, or any situation requiring text-to-speech capabilities. Its advanced features ensure that the synthesized speech is clear, natural, and closely resembles human speech.

name: SpeechT5 Text-to-Speech
description: This model, based on Microsoft's SpeechT5 architecture, specializes in converting text to speech. It leverages advanced neural network techniques to produce natural-sounding speech from textual input. SpeechT5 is ideal for applications like generating voiceovers, reading text aloud in assistive technologies, and creating spoken content from written material. It supports various languages and dialects, offering versatile applications in different domains.
examples: Reading out text for visually impaired users
Converting written news articles to audio format

News article content
Instructions or guidance text
Dialogue for a character in a game
Script for an automated announcement
